title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Service Operations Agent for conversational admin setup
summary: Hold: the briefing treats prepaid capacity coverage as undocumented even though the Dynamics 365 billing guidance linked from the agent's prerequisites describes prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go together, with prepaid capacity consumed first. The roadmap facts, agent permissions and capabilities, and billing CLI command are supported; the billing UI route also needs its remaining steps.

claims.fix: Replace the prepaid-capacity uncertainty in Cost and licensing with: 'The Dynamics 365 consumption-billing guidance linked from the agent prerequisites supports prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go on the same environment, with prepaid capacity consumed first.'
